problem_statement: Importing an ECDSA public key, and then signing and verifying with it, must succeed when the bit size given to the key attributes via psa_set_key_bits is the curve bit size the PSA specification assigns to the curve — 256 for SECP_R1 / P-256, i.e. ECC_KEY_SIZE — rather than a value derived from the byte length of the exported key encoding. Today these operations fail when the bit size is set to that spec value, because the implementation treats the supplied bit size as if it were a byte-length-derived quantity. The bit size a caller passes must be honored as the curve bit size so the example runs correctly without adjusting it to match the key encoding length.
